title: Rational P1 ambient comparison restriction on the untwisted base
statement: The intermediate categorical equality used by the rational projective-line second pull-section proof.

source.place: Second identity, intermediate transport and coherence.

proof.text: Apply the stated untwisted morphism equation and use it as the comm field of PullSectionCompatibility. The structure has exactly this one field.

proof_origin.place: Second identity, intermediate transport and coherence.
proof_origin.note: Use the already stated morphism equation, without adding any new proof obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem second_pull_section_core
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y)) :
    PullSectionCompatibility
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (firstProjection Y))
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y))
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (diagonalImmersion Y))
      (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (firstProjection Y)
        (by unfold firstProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_fst _))
      (pullSectionIso (coefficient l c).X Y (secondProjection Y)
        (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _))
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K)
      ((ambientPullbackComparison (coefficient l c).X (square Y)).symm.app K).inv

from.place: Strict intermediate step of the second identity
